body:

Largely DONE by the ENG entry-path retrofit: _start_pipeline enqueues via core.run_entry -> job_manager.enqueue; backlog items carried as item_id(s). Verify the gate end-to-end and close any gap: one canonical job per backlog item, no parallel path, result mirrors back to backlog. Gate: trace Backlog->Execute/Schedule->JobManager->claim->execution->finish ->backlog shows one canonical job.

[decision] P8A: single path already largely done (retrofit); gate = trace one item end-to-end.
